playerMetadata.pitch: At midnight, a hidden alley descends to a town of resurrected skeletons. Their wizard has vanished into a hallucinogenic fungal wilderness, the native Rixi have turned against corrupted undead, and somewhere beyond the electric river enormous fire-breathing worms are producing the stones that raise the dead.
playerMetadata.setting: Bonetown and the subterranean Fungal Forest

hard.rule: Bonetown is a functioning community of resurrected skeletons founded by Gebert.
Gebert begins trapped alive inside a Dim and has a 21-day rescue window from campaign start.
Dim produce Resurrection Stones, which can reanimate the dead but progressively corrupt resurrected skeletons.
The Rixi are native cavern inhabitants using eel-powered technology and are hostile to skeletons because corrupted skeletons attacked them.
The Mycelicardia is a malicious fungal network attempting to expand its influence toward the overworld.
The campaign is an open adventure site and does not require a single boss or mandatory path.

conditional.rule: At 21 elapsed days, Gebert becomes unrecoverable alive unless already rescued.
Harming an infected forest creature worsens the next forest danger through Mycelicardia awareness.
A freed Red Dragon acts on its own desire to burn the fungal network; rescue does not domesticate it.

soft.rule: Unnamed skeleton residents may be generated using the source NPC/rumour pattern.

freeImprovisation.rule: Ordinary dialogue, cavern ambience and non-keyed town detail may be improvised without changing faction knowledge or procedures.

endings.title: The Wizard Comes Home
endings.summary: Gebert is rescued before the 21-day deadline and returned to Bonetown; other cavern threats remain available.

endings.title: The Source of Resurrection
endings.summary: The party proves that Dim produce Resurrection Stones and can claim rewards even if Gebert is lost.

endings.title: Too Late
endings.summary: Gebert becomes unrecoverable after the deadline; the open cavern campaign continues.

endings.title: The Cavern Remains
endings.summary: Bonetown, Rixi, the dragon, fungal network, alchemy and Warrens remain a reusable adventure site after primary objectives resolve.

communityIntelligence.summary: Readers specifically praised the intelligent-skeleton premise, setting, NPCs and factions; one noted intelligent skeletons can confuse players if not established clearly.

adaptationNotes: Present skeleton/corrupted-skeleton/Rixi distinctions clearly in opening play.
Persist the 21-day Gebert deadline across sessions and overworld trips.
Store hallucinations as perception state, never automatic world truth.
Exact visual pointcrawl direct edges should be ingested when map assets are supported; source off-path travel provides a complete fallback without invented barriers.
ShareAlike obligations apply to this DMOS derivative campaign package.
